t: The LAP 2-Outlet type A & C plug-in USB adaptor plug delivers reliable 20W charging in a compact GaN design. This USB adaptor plug supports USB-C power delivery and USB-A quick charge 3.0 for efficient power distribution across compatible devices. With a 3A output shared between 2 x ports and a space-saving profile, it suits workshops, site offices and mobile charging setups where performance and durability matter.
